reporting-org.narrative: Norad - Norwegian Agency for Development Cooperation

title.narrative: EmpowerSUD: Strengthening Local Responders for Sustainable Humanitarian

description.narrative:
Empower local organizations to better address humanitarian crises in conflict zones and remote regions (in Sudan). The goal is to bolster their capacity to respond swiftly and effectively to crises, particularly those impacting displaced populations. The project targets five national non-governmental organizations (NNGOs), along with five community-based organizations (CBOs) to expand their impact with additional technical expertise and financial backing.
Outcomes 1. IDPs have improved access to WASH services. 2. IDPs improve access to food through self-reliance and income opportunities. 3. Women and girls have access to protection-relevant activities. 4. Individuals access assistance in a safe, inclusive, accountable and participatory manner. 5. Local partners have improved capacity to hum-response and system strengthening.
